{
  "world_updates": [],
  "memory_summary": "The player asks the Old Fletcher to tell them something about himself, prompting a reflective, world-worn response.",
  "new_entities": [],
  "rule_flags": [],
  "narration": "The Old Fletcher leans back in his chair, one hand resting on his knee, and looks out at the neatly stacked boxes of arrows as if recalling a long life in the same room.",
  "npc_response": "I've spent my days here longer than the road has had a name. I was a boy when the first siege came to this village, and I was old enough to string the first arrow of the last one. }
